failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'What colleges are located in Clark County, Nevada, and did Craig Heyer play sports at any of them?' - This is a natural-language yes/no question format with a compound multi-part ask bundling two separate targets (colleges in Clark County AND Craig Heyer's sports history).

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: All three hops retrieve the same Craig Heyer passage verbatim: 'Craig D. Heyer (born November 15, 1985) is an American professional baseball pitcher. Prior to becoming a professional, Heyer played college baseball at the College of Southern Nevada and University of Nevada, Las Vegas (UNLV).' Hop 1 retrieved this; hop 2 query asked about colleges in Clark County and Craig Heyer but retrieved the identical passage again; hop 3 query listed multiple entities but again retrieved the same Craig Heyer passage a third time, indicating queries failed to advance retrieval meaningfully.

failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: (i) Summary_1 explicitly names the missing entity: 'Both of these colleges are located in Clark County (as part of the Las Vegas metropolitan area)' - the solver assumes but does not verify that College of Southern Nevada is in Clark County. (ii) Hop 3 query targets this: 'Clark County Nevada, City of Las Vegas, Craig Heyer, College of Southern Nevada, University of Nevada Las Vegas, UNLV' explicitly includes 'College of Southern Nevada' but no passage confirming College of Southern Nevada's location in Clark County was retrieved across all three hops.

failure_modes.name: Verdict_Despite_Insufficiency
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_1 renders definitive verdict: 'The claim is **accurate**' and states 'Both of these colleges are located in Clark County (as part of the Las Vegas metropolitan area)' despite having no passage evidence confirming College of Southern Nevada is in Clark County. The solver makes an unverified location assumption about one of the two colleges Craig Heyer attended.
